annotations.title: Find agencies in a city or country

description: Find, list or compare maid / domestic-worker recruitment agencies (housemaids, nannies, cooks, drivers, caregivers) in a city or country - e.g. 'maid agencies in Dubai' -> city: Dubai. Use this for any 'agencies in <place>' question. Searches agencies listed on GCC Domestic across the six GCC countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). Filter by country, city and/or a free-text name query. Returns contact details, whether each agency is government-verified (1,300+ are), and the official registry link where one exists.

city.description: City name, e.g. Dubai, Riyadh, Doha

country.description: Country: uae | ksa | kuwait | qatar | bahrain | oman

query.description: Free-text search over agency names (English or Arabic)

name: search_agencies
title: Find agencies in a city or country
